name: SISTRIX
description: Give your AI SISTRIX SEO data: the Visibility Index (Sichtbarkeitsindex) and its history, ranking keywords, competitors, top URLs, keyword rankings, metrics and questions, and backlinks, with the credit cost of every call.
instructions:
## SISTRIX
This connector calls the **SISTRIX API** (`https://api.sistrix.com`) with the user's own API key: the SISTRIX Visibility Index (Sichtbarkeitsindex), domain key figures, ranking keywords, competitors, URLs, keyword rankings and metrics, questions and backlinks. Every tool is a read.

**Every call spends SISTRIX API credits** from the account's weekly allowance. Most functions cost 1 credit per row returned; `sistrix_domain_overview` costs 5, `sistrix_keyword_metrics` 5 per keyword, `sistrix_links_overview` 25. SISTRIX returns 100 rows when no limit is sent (10,000 links for backlinks), so every list tool here defaults to `limit` 10. `sistrix_get_credits` and `sistrix_list_countries` are free. Each answer ends with `credits_used`.

**Setup (about 2 minutes)**
1. API access and weekly credits come with SISTRIX plans from Plus upwards.
2. In the SISTRIX Toolbox open Account, API access (https://app.sistrix.com/account/api) and create or copy an API key.
3. Paste it into `SISTRIX_API_KEY` and install. SISTRIX takes the key as the `api_key` query parameter; it is stored encrypted, added to each request by the connector, and only sent to api.sistrix.com.

**Tools**
- `sistrix_get_credits`: credits left this week (free).
- `sistrix_list_countries`: supported country codes (free).
- `sistrix_domain_overview`: Visibility Index, SEO and Ads keyword counts (5 credits).
- `sistrix_visibility_index`: Visibility Index now, on a date or as history (1 per value).
- `sistrix_keyword_count`: number of ranking keywords, now or as history (1 per value).
- `sistrix_ranking_distribution`: keywords per result page (1 per date).
- `sistrix_competitors`: SEO competitors with similarity (1 per competitor).
- `sistrix_ranking_keywords`: keywords a domain ranks for, with position and URL (1 per keyword).
- `sistrix_top_urls`: best-ranking URLs (1 per URL).
- `sistrix_traffic_estimation`: paths with the most estimated clicks (1 per path).
- `sistrix_keyword_opportunities`: keywords close to page one (1 per keyword).
- `sistrix_keyword_serp`: who ranks for a keyword, or a site's ranking history (1 per ranking).
- `sistrix_keyword_metrics`: competition, CPC, traffic, clicks of a keyword (5).
- `sistrix_keyword_traffic`: search traffic and clicks, per country or over time (1 per value).
- `sistrix_keyword_questions`: question queries for a keyword (1 per question).
- `sistrix_links_overview`: backlink totals (25 credits).
- `sistrix_backlinks`: backlinks (1 per link, at most 250).
- `sistrix_link_texts`: anchor texts (1 per text).

**What to analyse**: domain tools take exactly one of `domain` (sistrix.de, with all subdomains), `host` (www.sistrix.de), `path` (www.sistrix.de/news/) or `url` (one page). `country` is a lower-case code (de, at, ch, uk, us, it, fr, es...); without it SISTRIX uses the account's default country, usually de. `date` (YYYY-MM-DD) asks for the weekly value of a past week.

**Reading the answers**: `answer` holds the data, `info` the country and object analysed, `credits_used` the credits spent. The Visibility Index appears as `sichtbarkeitsindex` (value with date). `traffic` on keywords is SISTRIX's search traffic index from 0 to 100, not visits; `competition` is 0 to 100.

**Common errors** (SISTRIX answers `{"status": "error", "error": [{"error_code": ..., "error_message": ...}]}`)
- 100 wrong api key / 403 permission denied: the key is wrong or the plan has no API access (code 5000).
- 200 not enough credits: the weekly credits are used up; `sistrix_get_credits` shows the balance.
- 1000 no results, 2000 domain not found, 3000 keyword not found: SISTRIX has no data for this object in this country.
- 1002 / 1003 invalid or missing parameters: for example no domain, host, path or url given.
- 429 too many requests: SISTRIX allows 300 requests a minute.

**Official MCP server**: SISTRIX also runs its own MCP server (https://api.sistrix.com/mcp/, OAuth sign-in) that does not spend API credits; this connector uses the REST API with an API key instead.

**Out of scope here**: SISTRIX projects (Optimizer), the AI visibility functions, the Amazon marketplace functions, Google Ads (SEM) data and bulk keyword requests.

SISTRIX_API_KEY.label: SISTRIX API key
SISTRIX_API_KEY.help: SISTRIX Toolbox, Account, API access. Plans from Plus upwards include weekly API credits; every call spends some.
SISTRIX_API_KEY.patternMessage: Paste only the API key, without spaces or an api_key= prefix.

verifyHints.401: SISTRIX refused the API key. Copy it again from https://app.sistrix.com/account/api.
verifyHints.403: SISTRIX refused the request (permission denied): the API key is wrong, or the plan has no API access. Check https://app.sistrix.com/account/api.
verifyHints.429: SISTRIX is rate limiting this key (300 requests a minute). Wait a moment and verify again.

prerequisites: A SISTRIX plan with API access (Plus or higher) and its API key from the Toolbox, Account, API access. Every call spends API credits from the weekly allowance. About 2 minutes.

tools.name: sistrix_get_credits
tools.description: Show how many SISTRIX API credits this key has left this week. Free: costs no credits.

transform.expression: {info: info[0], answer: answer[0], date: date[0][0], credits_used: credits[0].used} | from_items(items(@)[?[1] != null])

tools.description: SISTRIX Visibility Index (Sichtbarkeitsindex) of a domain, host, path or URL: the current value, the value of a past week (date), or the weekly history (history=true), or the daily values of the last 30 days (daily=true). Costs 1 credit per value returned; the full history can be hundreds of values, so set limit.

domain.description: Domain to analyse, e.g. sistrix.de. Set exactly one of domain, host, path or url.

host.description: Hostname (subdomain), e.g. www.sistrix.de. Instead of domain.
